segments.src: ## Why the chair sat empty so long
segments.tr: ## لماذا ظل الكرسي شاغرًا لفترة طويلة

segments.src: The vacancy traces back to the summer of 2025.
segments.tr: يعود الشغور إلى صيف عام 2025.

segments.src: The CDC director became a Senate-confirmed position beginning in January 2025, the result of a change Congress wrote into appropriations law in 2022.
segments.tr: أصبح مدير مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها منصبًا يتطلب تأكيد مجلس الشيوخ بدءًا من يناير 2025، نتيجة لتغيير كتبه الكونجرس في قانون المخصصات لعام 2022.

segments.src: Before that, the director was appointed directly by the Secretary of Health and Human Services — no hearing, no floor vote, no confirmation fight.
segments.tr: قبل ذلك، كان المدير يُعين مباشرة من قبل وزير الصحة والخدمات الإنسانية - دون جلسة استماع، ولا تصويت في القاعة، ولا صراع على التأكيد.

segments.src: A president could install a new director in an afternoon.
segments.tr: كان بإمكان الرئيس تنصيب مدير جديد في فترة ما بعد الظهر.

segments.src: The first director confirmed under the new rules took office in July 2025 and departed roughly a month later amid a public dispute over the agency's direction.
segments.tr: تولى أول مدير تم تأكيده بموجب القواعد الجديدة منصبه في يوليو 2025 وغادر بعد نحو شهر وسط نزاع علني حول توجه الوكالة.

segments.src: Several senior CDC officials resigned in the days that followed.
segments.tr: استقال العديد من كبار مسؤولي مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها في الأيام التي تلت ذلك.

segments.src: The agency was then run on an acting basis by an official detailed from the department's leadership — a workable arrangement for weeks, an awkward one for months.
segments.tr: ثم أدارت الوكالة بصفة مؤقتة من قبل مسؤول مفوض من قيادة الوزارة - وهو ترتيب عملي لأسابيع، ولكن محرج لشهور.

segments.src: A subsequent attempt to fill the job permanently did not survive the confirmation process.
segments.tr: ولم تنجُ محاولة لاحقة لملء المنصب بشكل دائم من عملية التأكيد.

segments.src: Meanwhile the agency absorbed budget reductions and staff departures that thinned out parts of its workforce.
segments.tr: وفي الوقت نفسه، استوعبت الوكالة تخفيضات في الميزانية ومغادرات للموظفين أدت إلى تقليص أجزاء من قوتها العاملة.

segments.src: The result was an institution operating for the better part of a year without a leader who could credibly say they'd be there in six months.
segments.tr: وكانت النتيجة مؤسسة تعمل للجزء الأكبر من العام بدون قائد يمكنه القول بمصداقية إنه سيكون موجودًا بعد ستة أشهر.

segments.src: That matters more than it sounds.
segments.tr: وهذا الأمر أهم مما يبدو.

segments.src: Acting directors can keep the lights on, sign what needs signing, and manage an emergency if one arrives.
segments.tr: يمكن للمديرين المؤقتين الحفاظ على سير العمل، وتوقيع ما يجب توقيعه، وإدارة حالة طوارئ إذا حدثت.

segments.src: What they generally cannot do is make multi-year commitments — reorganize divisions, launch long-horizon surveillance programs, or recruit senior scientists who want to know who their boss will be.
segments.tr: ما لا يمكنهم فعله بشكل عام هو تقديم التزامات لعدة سنوات - إعادة تنظيم الأقسام، أو إطلاق برامج مراقبة طويلة الأمد، أو توظيف علماء كبار يريدون معرفة من سيكون رئيسهم.

segments.src: Career staff learn to wait out temporary leadership.
segments.tr: يتعلم الموظفون المهنيون انتظار انتهاء القيادة المؤقتة.

segments.src: Vacancies at the top tend to freeze decisions several layers down.
segments.tr: وتميل الشواغر في القمة إلى تجميد القرارات في عدة مستويات أدنى.

segments.src: ## The office became partisan before the person did
segments.tr: ## أصبح المكتب حزبيًا قبل أن يصبح الشخص كذلك

segments.src: It's tempting to read a 51–44 margin as a verdict on one nominee.
segments.tr: من المغري قراءة هامش 51-44 كحكم على مرشح واحد.

segments.src: It's more useful to read it as a verdict on the job.
segments.tr: لكن من الأكثر فائدة قراءته كحكم على الوظيفة.

segments.src: Confirmation votes for public health agency leadership were not always contested affairs.
segments.tr: لم تكن تصويتات التأكيد لقيادة وكالة الصحة العامة دائمًا شؤونًا متنازعًا عليها.

segments.src: The change in 2022 that made the CDC director subject to Senate confirmation was framed at the time as an accountability measure — a response to the sense, held in different forms across the political spectrum, that the agency had made consequential decisions during the pandemic without enough external check.
segments.tr: التغيير في عام 2022 الذي جعل مدير مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها خاضعًا لتأكيد مجلس الشيوخ تم تأطيره في ذلك الوقت كإجراء للمساءلة - استجابة للشعور، الذي ساد بأشكال مختلفة عبر الطيف السياسي، بأن الوكالة اتخذت قرارات مصيرية خلال الجائحة دون رقابة خارجية كافية.

segments.src: The predictable second-order effect is now visible.
segments.tr: والآن أصبح التأثير من الدرجة الثانية المتوقع مرئيًا.

segments.src: Once a post requires 51 votes, it acquires the properties of every other job that requires 51 votes.
segments.tr: بمجرد أن يتطلب المنصب 51 صوتًا، فإنه يكتسب خصائص كل وظيفة أخرى تتطلب 51 صوتًا.

segments.src: Nominees are evaluated partly on credentials and partly on which coalition they're understood to belong to.
segments.tr: يتم تقييم المرشحين جزئيًا بناءً على مؤهلاتهم وجزئيًا بناءً على التحالف الذي يُفهم أنهم ينتمون إليه.

segments.src: Hearings become opportunities to litigate the last five years of health policy with a person who wasn't in charge for any of it.
segments.tr: تصبح جلسات الاستماع فرصًا للتقاضي بشأن سياسة الصحة في السنوات الخمس الماضية مع شخص لم يكن مسؤولاً عن أي منها.

segments.src: And the seat can sit empty for a year, because an empty seat is a survivable outcome for everyone except the agency.
segments.tr: ويمكن أن يظل المقعد شاغرًا لمدة عام، لأن المقعد الشاغر نتيجة يمكن تحملها للجميع باستثناء الوكالة.

segments.src: Accountability and paralysis turn out to be produced by the same mechanism.
segments.tr: يتبين أن المساءلة والشلل يتم إنتاجهما بواسطة نفس الآلية.

segments.src: That's not an argument that the 2022 change was wrong — reasonable people land in different places on whether a director of a 10,000-person agency with emergency authorities should face a public vote.
segments.tr: هذا ليس حجة بأن تغيير عام 2022 كان خاطئًا - فالأشخاص العقلانيون يختلفون في آرائهم حول ما إذا كان يجب أن يواجه مدير وكالة تضم 10,000 شخص بصلاحيات طوارئ تصويتًا علنيًا.

segments.src: But it is the trade-off, and this vacancy is the clearest demonstration of it so far.
segments.tr: لكنه المقايضة، وهذا الشغور هو أوضح دليل على ذلك حتى الآن.

segments.src: ## What lands on her desk
segments.tr: ## ما الذي سيوضع على مكتبها

segments.src: The incoming director inherits a specific and unglamorous list.
segments.tr: يرث المدير القادم قائمة محددة وغير جذابة.

segments.src: **Staffing.** Budget reductions and resignations have left gaps, including in senior scientific ranks.
segments.tr: **التوظيف.** تركت تخفيضات الميزانية والاستقالات فجوات، بما في ذلك في الرتب العلمية العليا.

segments.src: Rebuilding takes longer than cutting, and the people who left had institutional knowledge that doesn't come back with the job posting.
segments.tr: إعادة البناء تستغرق وقتًا أطول من القطع، والأشخاص الذين غادروا كانوا يمتلكون معرفة مؤسسية لا تعود مع إعلان الوظيفة.

segments.src: **The advisory apparatus.** The CDC relies on outside expert committees whose composition and processes have been the subject of sustained public argument.
segments.tr: **جهاز الاستشارة.** يعتمد مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها على لجان خبراء خارجية كان تكوينها وعملياتها موضوعًا لنقاش علني مستمر.

segments.src: How the new director handles those bodies will be an early signal of how much independence the agency's scientific process is understood to have.
segments.tr: كيف سيتعامل المدير الجديد مع هذه الهيئات سيكون إشارة مبكرة إلى مدى الاستقلال الذي يُفهم أن العملية العلمية للوكالة تتمتع به.

segments.src: **Trust, which is not one number.** Public confidence in the CDC is not uniformly high or uniformly low — it varies enormously by political affiliation, and the gap between groups is now wider than it was before 2020.
segments.tr: **الثقة، وهي ليست رقمًا واحدًا.** الثقة العامة في مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها ليست عالية بشكل موحد أو منخفضة بشكل موحد - فهي تختلف بشكل كبير حسب الانتماء السياسي، والفجوة بين المجموعات الآن أوسع مما كانت عليه قبل عام 2020.

segments.src: A director cannot close that gap by communicating more clearly, though communicating clearly helps.
segments.tr: لا يمكن للمدير سد هذه الفجوة من خلال التواصل بشكل أكثر وضوحًا، رغم أن التواصل الواضح يساعد.

segments.src: It's a structural problem the agency did not create alone and cannot solve alone.
segments.tr: إنها مشكلة هيكلية لم تخلقها الوكالة بمفردها ولا يمكنها حلها بمفردها.

segments.src: **The next outbreak, whenever it is.** This is the part no one can schedule.
segments.tr: **التفشي القادم، في أي وقت كان.** هذا هو الجزء الذي لا يمكن لأحد جدولته.

segments.src: The practical test of any CDC director is how the agency performs in the first ninety days of something nobody saw coming — and that test is graded on preparation done long beforehand.
segments.tr: الاختبار العملي لأي مدير لمركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها هو كيف سيكون أداء الوكالة في التسعين يومًا الأولى من شيء لم يتوقعه أحد - وهذا الاختبار يتم تقييمه بناءً على الاستعدادات التي تمت قبل فترة طويلة.

segments.src: **Being the first.** The historic dimension of the appointment carries its own weight.
segments.tr: **كونها الأولى.** البعد التاريخي للتعيين يحمل ثقله الخاص.

segments.src: Firsts are scrutinized differently, and the scrutiny doesn't lift after the first year.
segments.tr: يتم تدقيق 'الأوائل' بشكل مختلف، وهذا التدقيق لا يزول بعد العام الأول.

segments.src: ## What we know, and what we don't
segments.tr: ## ما نعرفه، وما لا نعرفه

segments.src: Worth separating clearly, because early coverage of any confirmation blends the two.
segments.tr: من الجدير فصلهما بوضوح، لأن التغطية المبكرة لأي تأكيد تخلط بين الاثنين.

segments.src: **Established:** the date, the 51–44 margin, the roughly party-line split, the length of the vacancy, and the historic nature of the appointment.
segments.tr: **المؤكد:** التاريخ، وهامش 51-44، والانقسام الحزبي التقريبي، وطول فترة الشغور، والطبيعة التاريخية للتعيين.

segments.src: **Not yet established:** what she will actually do.
segments.tr: **غير المؤكد بعد:** ما الذي ستفعله فعليًا.

segments.src: Confirmation hearings are a poor predictor of governance.
segments.tr: جلسات استماع التأكيد هي مؤشر ضعيف على الحوكمة.

segments.src: Nominees answer hypotheticals under adversarial conditions; directors make decisions under real ones with information the hearing room didn't have.
segments.tr: يجيب المرشحون على افتراضات في ظروف عدائية؛ أما المديرون فيتخذون قرارات في ظروف حقيقية بمعلومات لم تكن متوفرة في غرفة الجلسة.

segments.src: Personnel choices in the first sixty days will say more than anything said in testimony.
segments.tr: اختيارات الموظفين في أول ستين يومًا ستقول أكثر من أي شيء قيل في الشهادة.

segments.src: **Contested:** essentially all of the surrounding interpretation.
segments.tr: **المتنازع عليه:** أساسًا كل التفسيرات المحيطة.

segments.src: Whether the last year represents necessary correction or damaging disruption is a live political argument, and coverage of this confirmation will reflect whichever answer the outlet already holds.
segments.tr: سواء كان العام الماضي يمثل تصحيحًا ضروريًا أو اضطرابًا ضارًا هو جدال سياسي قائم، وستعكس التغطية لهذا التأكيد أي إجابة تتبناها الوسيلة الإعلامية بالفعل.

segments.src: Reading across sources is more useful here than usual.
segments.tr: القراءة عبر مصادر متعددة أكثر فائدة هنا من المعتاد.

segments.src: ## Why this is worth following
segments.tr: ## لماذا يستحق هذا المتابعة

segments.src: The CDC is an agency most Americans think about only when something has gone wrong — which means the periods when nothing is going wrong are exactly when its capacity gets built or quietly eroded.
segments.tr: مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها هو وكالة يفكر فيها معظم الأمريكيين فقط عندما يحدث خطأ ما - مما يعني أن الفترات التي لا يحدث فيها خطأ ما هي بالضبط الفترات التي يتم فيها بناء قدراتها أو تآكلها بهدوء.

segments.src: A confirmed director doesn't fix an agency.
segments.tr: المدير المؤكد لا يصلح الوكالة.

segments.src: It restores the precondition for fixing one: someone with the standing to make decisions that outlast the news cycle, and the accountability that comes with having been voted on in public.
segments.tr: بل يعيد الشرط المسبق لإصلاحها: شخص لديه المكانة لاتخاذ قرارات تدوم لفترة أطول من الدورة الإخبارية، والمساءلة التي تأتي مع كونه قد تم التصويت عليه علنًا.

segments.src: Whether the vote that ended the vacancy also ended the underlying instability is a separate question.
segments.tr: سواء كان التصويت الذي أنهى الشغور قد أنهى أيضًا عدم الاستقرار الأساسي هو سؤال منفصل.

segments.src: Nothing about a 51–44 margin suggests the argument is over.
segments.tr: لا يوجد شيء في هامش 51-44 يشير إلى أن الجدال قد انتهى.

segments.src: It suggests the argument now has a permanent address.
segments.tr: بل يشير إلى أن الجدال الآن لديه عنوان دائم.

segments.src: *This article summarizes publicly reported developments as of August 7, 2026.
segments.tr: *يلخص هذا المقال التطورات التي تم الإبلاغ عنها علنًا حتى 7 أغسطس 2026.

segments.src: Details of personnel decisions and agency policy may change; for official announcements, consult the CDC and the Department of Health and Human Services directly, and check current reporting from established news organizations for the latest developments.*
segments.tr: قد تتغير تفاصيل قرارات الموظفين وسياسة الوكالة؛ للحصول على الإعلانات الرسمية، يرجى مراجعة مركز السيطرة على الأمراض والوقاية منها ووزارة الصحة والخدمات الإنسانية مباشرة، والتحقق من التقارير الحالية من المنظمات الإخبارية المعتمدة لآخر التطورات.*

fr.title: Le CDC a passé près d'un an sans directeur confirmé. Un vote de 51–44 vient d'y mettre fin.

segments.src: On August 5, the Senate voted 51–44 to confirm Dr.
segments.tr: Le 5 août, le Sénat a voté à 51–44 pour confirmer le Dr

segments.src: Erica Schwartz as director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention — closing out a vacancy that had stretched for close to a year at the agency responsible for tracking and responding to disease outbreaks in the United States.
segments.tr: Erica Schwartz en tant que directrice des Centers for Disease Control and Prevention — mettant fin à une vacance qui s'était prolongée pendant près d'un an au sein de l'agence responsable du suivi et de la réponse aux épidémies aux États-Unis.

segments.src: She becomes the CDC's 22nd director and the first Black woman to hold the post.
segments.tr: Elle devient la 22e directrice du CDC et la première femme noire à occuper ce poste.

segments.src: Both halves of that sentence deserve attention, but so does the number attached to it.
segments.tr: Les deux parties de cette phrase méritent l'attention, tout comme le chiffre qui y est associé.

segments.src: A seven-vote margin, along a mostly party-line split, is not how the top job at a scientific agency was historically filled.
segments.tr: Une marge de sept voix, suivant un clivage principalement partisan, n'est pas la manière dont le poste le plus élevé d'une agence scientifique a été historiquement pourvu.

segments.src: For most of the CDC's history, it wasn't filled by a Senate vote at all.
segments.tr: Pendant la majeure partie de l'histoire du CDC, il n'était pas pourvu par un vote du Sénat du tout.

segments.src: ## What the Senate actually did
segments.tr: ## Ce que le Sénat a réellement fait

segments.src: The vote itself was procedurally ordinary and politically anything but.
segments.tr: Le vote lui-même était procéduralement ordinaire et politiquement tout sauf cela.

segments.src: Fifty-one senators voted yes, forty-four voted no, and the tally broke largely along party lines.
segments.tr: Cinquante et un sénateurs ont voté oui, quarante-quatre ont voté non, et le décompte s'est largement effectué selon les lignes partisanes.

segments.src: What makes the outcome notable is that, only weeks earlier, the nomination looked finished.
segments.tr: Ce qui rend le résultat notable, c'est que, quelques semaines seulement auparavant, la nomination semblait terminée.

segments.src: Schwartz had a rough outing before the committee that handles health nominations — the kind of hearing where a nominee absorbs sustained questioning, gives answers that satisfy few people in the room, and leaves with the whip count moving in the wrong direction.
segments.tr: Schwartz a eu un passage difficile devant le comité qui s'occupe des nominations en santé — le genre d'audience où un candidat absorbe un interrogatoire soutenu, donne des réponses qui satisfont peu de personnes dans la salle, et repart avec un décompte de voix évoluant dans la mauvaise direction.

segments.src: Nominations that stumble at that stage frequently do not recover.
segments.tr: Les nominations qui trébuchent à ce stade ne s'en remettent fréquemment pas.

segments.src: Senators quietly signal that they'd rather not have to vote, the White House quietly looks elsewhere, and the nomination expires without a floor vote ever being scheduled.
segments.tr: Les sénateurs signalent discrètement qu'ils préféreraient ne pas avoir à voter, la Maison Blanche cherche discrètement ailleurs, et la nomination expire sans qu'un vote en séance soit jamais programmé.

segments.src: That is roughly what had already happened once in this seat.
segments.tr: C'est approximativement ce qui s'était déjà produit une fois pour ce poste.

segments.src: This time it didn't.
segments.tr: Cette fois, ce ne fut pas le cas.

segments.src: ## Why the chair sat empty so long
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi le fauteuil est resté vide si longtemps

segments.src: The vacancy traces back to the summer of 2025.
segments.tr: La vacance remonte à l'été 2025.

segments.src: The CDC director became a Senate-confirmed position beginning in January 2025, the result of a change Congress wrote into appropriations law in 2022.
segments.tr: Le poste de directeur du CDC est devenu un poste confirmé par le Sénat à partir de janvier 2025, résultat d'un changement que le Congrès a inscrit dans la loi sur les crédits en 2022.

segments.src: Before that, the director was appointed directly by the Secretary of Health and Human Services — no hearing, no floor vote, no confirmation fight.
segments.tr: Avant cela, le directeur était nommé directement par le secrétaire à la Santé et aux Services sociaux — pas d'audience, pas de vote en séance, pas de combat de confirmation.

segments.src: A president could install a new director in an afternoon.
segments.tr: Un président pouvait installer un nouveau directeur en un après-midi.

segments.src: The first director confirmed under the new rules took office in July 2025 and departed roughly a month later amid a public dispute over the agency's direction.
segments.tr: Le premier directeur confirmé selon les nouvelles règles a pris ses fonctions en juillet 2025 et est parti environ un mois plus tard suite à un différend public sur l'orientation de l'agence.

segments.src: Several senior CDC officials resigned in the days that followed.
segments.tr: Plusieurs hauts fonctionnaires du CDC ont démissionné dans les jours qui ont suivi.

segments.src: The agency was then run on an acting basis by an official detailed from the department's leadership — a workable arrangement for weeks, an awkward one for months.
segments.tr: L'agence était ensuite dirigée par intérim par un fonctionnaire détaché de la direction du département — un arrangement viable pendant quelques semaines, maladroit pendant des mois.

segments.src: A subsequent attempt to fill the job permanently did not survive the confirmation process.
segments.tr: Une tentative ultérieure de pourvoir le poste de manière permanente n'a pas survécu au processus de confirmation.

segments.src: Meanwhile the agency absorbed budget reductions and staff departures that thinned out parts of its workforce.
segments.tr: Pendant ce temps, l'agence a absorbé des réductions budgétaires et des départs de personnel qui ont aminci certaines parties de son effectif.

segments.src: The result was an institution operating for the better part of a year without a leader who could credibly say they'd be there in six months.
segments.tr: Le résultat a été une institution fonctionnant pendant la majeure partie d'une année sans un leader capable de dire crédiblement qu'il serait là dans six mois.

segments.src: That matters more than it sounds.
segments.tr: Cela importe plus qu'il n'y paraît.

segments.src: Acting directors can keep the lights on, sign what needs signing, and manage an emergency if one arrives.
segments.tr: Les directeurs par intérim peuvent maintenir les lumières allumées, signer ce qui doit être signé et gérer une urgence si elle survient.

segments.src: What they generally cannot do is make multi-year commitments — reorganize divisions, launch long-horizon surveillance programs, or recruit senior scientists who want to know who their boss will be.
segments.tr: Ce qu'ils ne peuvent généralement pas faire, c'est prendre des engagements pluriannuels — réorganiser des divisions, lancer des programmes de surveillance à long terme ou recruter des scientifiques seniors qui veulent savoir qui sera leur patron.

segments.src: Career staff learn to wait out temporary leadership.
segments.tr: Le personnel de carrière apprend à attendre la fin de la direction temporaire.

segments.src: Vacancies at the top tend to freeze decisions several layers down.
segments.tr: Les vacances au sommet ont tendance à geler les décisions à plusieurs niveaux inférieurs.

segments.src: ## The office became partisan before the person did
segments.tr: ## Le bureau est devenu partisan avant que la personne ne le devienne

segments.src: It's tempting to read a 51–44 margin as a verdict on one nominee.
segments.tr: Il est tentant de lire une marge de 51–44 comme un verdict sur un candidat.

segments.src: It's more useful to read it as a verdict on the job.
segments.tr: Il est plus utile de le lire comme un verdict sur le poste.

segments.src: Confirmation votes for public health agency leadership were not always contested affairs.
segments.tr: Les votes de confirmation pour la direction d'une agence de santé publique n'ont pas toujours été des affaires contestées.

segments.src: The change in 2022 that made the CDC director subject to Senate confirmation was framed at the time as an accountability measure — a response to the sense, held in different forms across the political spectrum, that the agency had made consequential decisions during the pandemic without enough external check.
segments.tr: Le changement en 2022 qui a rendu le directeur du CDC sujet à la confirmation du Sénat a été présenté à l'époque comme une mesure de responsabilité — une réponse au sentiment, partagé sous différentes formes à travers le spectre politique, que l'agence avait pris des décisions conséquentes pendant la pandémie sans assez de contrôle externe.

segments.src: The predictable second-order effect is now visible.
segments.tr: L'effet de second ordre prévisible est maintenant visible.

segments.src: Once a post requires 51 votes, it acquires the properties of every other job that requires 51 votes.
segments.tr: Une fois qu'un poste nécessite 51 voix, il acquiert les propriétés de tout autre poste qui nécessite 51 voix.

segments.src: Nominees are evaluated partly on credentials and partly on which coalition they're understood to belong to.
segments.tr: Les candidats sont évalués en partie sur leurs compétences et en partie sur la coalition à laquelle ils sont censés appartenir.

segments.src: Hearings become opportunities to litigate the last five years of health policy with a person who wasn't in charge for any of it.
segments.tr: Les audiences deviennent des occasions de litiger les cinq dernières années de politique de santé avec une personne qui n'était pas responsable de quoi que ce soit durant cette période.

segments.src: And the seat can sit empty for a year, because an empty seat is a survivable outcome for everyone except the agency.
segments.tr: Et le siège peut rester vide pendant un an, parce qu'un siège vide est un résultat survivable pour tout le monde sauf pour l'agence.

segments.src: Accountability and paralysis turn out to be produced by the same mechanism.
segments.tr: La responsabilité et la paralysie s'avèrent être produites par le même mécanisme.

segments.src: That's not an argument that the 2022 change was wrong — reasonable people land in different places on whether a director of a 10,000-person agency with emergency authorities should face a public vote.
segments.tr: Ce n'est pas un argument pour dire que le changement de 2022 était erroné — des personnes raisonnables peuvent avoir des avis différents sur le fait qu'un directeur d'une agence de 10 000 personnes avec des pouvoirs d'urgence doive faire l'objet d'un vote public.

segments.src: But it is the trade-off, and this vacancy is the clearest demonstration of it so far.
segments.tr: Mais c'est le compromis, et cette vacance est la démonstration la plus claire jusqu'à présent.

segments.src: ## What lands on her desk
segments.tr: ## Ce qui arrive sur son bureau

segments.src: The incoming director inherits a specific and unglamorous list.
segments.tr: La nouvelle directrice hérite d'une liste spécifique et peu attrayante.

segments.src: **Staffing.** Budget reductions and resignations have left gaps, including in senior scientific ranks.
segments.tr: **Le personnel.** Les réductions budgétaires et les démissions ont laissé des vides, notamment dans les rangs scientifiques seniors.

segments.src: Rebuilding takes longer than cutting, and the people who left had institutional knowledge that doesn't come back with the job posting.
segments.tr: Reconstruire prend plus de temps que couper, et les personnes qui sont parties avaient une connaissance institutionnelle qui ne revient pas avec l'offre d'emploi.

segments.src: **The advisory apparatus.** The CDC relies on outside expert committees whose composition and processes have been the subject of sustained public argument.
segments.tr: **L'appareil consultatif.** Le CDC s'appuie sur des comités d'experts externes dont la composition et les processus ont fait l'objet d'arguments publics soutenus.

segments.src: How the new director handles those bodies will be an early signal of how much independence the agency's scientific process is understood to have.
segments.tr: La manière dont la nouvelle directrice gérera ces organes sera un signal précoce du degré d'indépendance que le processus scientifique de l'agence est censé avoir.

segments.src: **Trust, which is not one number.** Public confidence in the CDC is not uniformly high or uniformly low — it varies enormously by political affiliation, and the gap between groups is now wider than it was before 2020.
segments.tr: **La confiance, qui n'est pas un chiffre unique.** La confiance du public dans le CDC n'est pas uniformément haute ou uniformément basse — elle varie énormément selon l'affiliation politique, et l'écart entre les groupes est maintenant plus large qu'il ne l'était avant 2020.

segments.src: A director cannot close that gap by communicating more clearly, though communicating clearly helps.
segments.tr: Un directeur ne peut pas combler cet écart en communiquant plus clairement, bien que communiquer clairement aide.

segments.src: It's a structural problem the agency did not create alone and cannot solve alone.
segments.tr: C'est un problème structurel que l'agence n'a pas créé seule et ne peut résoudre seule.

segments.src: **The next outbreak, whenever it is.** This is the part no one can schedule.
segments.tr: **La prochaine épidémie, quand elle arrivera.** C'est la partie que personne ne peut programmer.

segments.src: The practical test of any CDC director is how the agency performs in the first ninety days of something nobody saw coming — and that test is graded on preparation done long beforehand.
segments.tr: Le test pratique de tout directeur du CDC est la manière dont l'agence performe dans les quatre-vingt-dix premiers jours de quelque chose que personne n'avait vu venir — et ce test est noté sur la préparation faite longtemps à l'avance.

segments.src: **Being the first.** The historic dimension of the appointment carries its own weight.
segments.tr: **Être la première.** La dimension historique de la nomination comporte son propre poids.

segments.src: Firsts are scrutinized differently, and the scrutiny doesn't lift after the first year.
segments.tr: Les premières sont scrutées différemment, et le scrutin ne s'atténue pas après la première année.

segments.src: ## What we know, and what we don't
segments.tr: ## Ce que nous savons, et ce que nous ne savons pas

segments.src: Worth separating clearly, because early coverage of any confirmation blends the two.
segments.tr: Il vaut mieux les séparer clairement, car la couverture médiatique précoce de toute confirmation mélange les deux.

segments.src: **Established:** the date, the 51–44 margin, the roughly party-line split, the length of the vacancy, and the historic nature of the appointment.
segments.tr: **Établi :** la date, la marge de 51–44, le clivage approximativement partisan, la durée de la vacance, et la nature historique de la nomination.

segments.src: **Not yet established:** what she will actually do.
segments.tr: **Pas encore établi :** ce qu'elle fera réellement.

segments.src: Confirmation hearings are a poor predictor of governance.
segments.tr: Les audiences de confirmation sont un mauvais prédicteur de gouvernance.

segments.src: Nominees answer hypotheticals under adversarial conditions; directors make decisions under real ones with information the hearing room didn't have.
segments.tr: Les candidats répondent à des hypothèses dans des conditions adverses ; les directeurs prennent des décisions dans des conditions réelles avec des informations que la salle d'audience n'avait pas.

segments.src: Personnel choices in the first sixty days will say more than anything said in testimony.
segments.tr: Les choix de personnel dans les soixante premiers jours en diront plus que tout ce qui a été dit lors du témoignage.

segments.src: **Contested:** essentially all of the surrounding interpretation.
segments.tr: **Contesté :** essentiellement toute l'interprétation environnante.

segments.src: Whether the last year represents necessary correction or damaging disruption is a live political argument, and coverage of this confirmation will reflect whichever answer the outlet already holds.
segments.tr: Que la dernière année représente une correction nécessaire ou une perturbation dommageable est un argument politique actuel, et la couverture de cette confirmation reflétera la réponse que le média détient déjà.

segments.src: Reading across sources is more useful here than usual.
segments.tr: Lire différentes sources est plus utile ici que d'habitude.

segments.src: ## Why this is worth following
segments.tr: ## Pourquoi cela vaut la peine d'être suivi

segments.src: The CDC is an agency most Americans think about only when something has gone wrong — which means the periods when nothing is going wrong are exactly when its capacity gets built or quietly eroded.
segments.tr: Le CDC est une agence dont la plupart des Américains ne pensent qu'à quand quelque chose a mal tourné — ce qui signifie que les périodes où rien ne va mal sont exactement celles où sa capacité se construit ou s'érode discrètement.

segments.src: A confirmed director doesn't fix an agency.
segments.tr: Un directeur confirmé ne répare pas une agence.

segments.src: It restores the precondition for fixing one: someone with the standing to make decisions that outlast the news cycle, and the accountability that comes with having been voted on in public.
segments.tr: Cela rétablit la condition préalable pour en réparer une : quelqu'un avec l'autorité pour prendre des décisions qui durent plus longtemps que le cycle d'actualité, et la responsabilité qui accompagne le fait d'avoir été voté publiquement.

segments.src: Whether the vote that ended the vacancy also ended the underlying instability is a separate question.
segments.tr: Que le vote qui a mis fin à la vacance a également mis fin à l'instabilité sous-jacente est une question distincte.

segments.src: Nothing about a 51–44 margin suggests the argument is over.
segments.tr: Rien dans une marge de 51–44 ne suggère que l'argument est terminé.

segments.src: It suggests the argument now has a permanent address.
segments.tr: Cela suggère que l'argument a maintenant une adresse permanente.

segments.src: *This article summarizes publicly reported developments as of August 7, 2026.
segments.tr: *Cet article résume les développements rapportés publiquement au 7 août 2026.

segments.src: Details of personnel decisions and agency policy may change; for official announcements, consult the CDC and the Department of Health and Human Services directly, and check current reporting from established news organizations for the latest developments.*
segments.tr: Les détails des décisions de personnel et de la politique de l'agence peuvent changer ; pour des annonces officielles, consultez directement le CDC et le Département de la Santé et des Services sociaux, et vérifiez les rapports actuels des organisations de presse établies pour les derniers développements.*

pt.title: O CDC passou quase um ano sem um diretor confirmado. Uma votação de 51–44 acabou com isso.

segments.src: On August 5, the Senate voted 51–44 to confirm Dr.
segments.tr: Em 5 de agosto, o Senado votou 51–44 para confirmar a Dra.

segments.src: Erica Schwartz as director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention — closing out a vacancy that had stretched for close to a year at the agency responsible for tracking and responding to disease outbreaks in the United States.
segments.tr: Erica Schwartz como diretora dos Centros de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças — encerrando uma vacância que se estendeu por quase um ano na agância responsável por rastrear e responder a surtos de doenças nos Estados Unidos.

segments.src: She becomes the CDC's 22nd director and the first Black woman to hold the post.
segments.tr: Ela se torna a 22ª diretora do CDC e a primeira mulher negra a ocupar o cargo.

segments.src: Both halves of that sentence deserve attention, but so does the number attached to it.
segments.tr: Ambas as partes dessa frase merecem atenção, mas o nómero associado a ela também merece.

segments.src: A seven-vote margin, along a mostly party-line split, is not how the top job at a scientific agency was historically filled.
segments.tr: Uma margem de sete votos, seguindo majoritariamente a linha partidária, não é como o cargo mais alto de uma agância científica era historicamente preenchido.

segments.src: For most of the CDC's history, it wasn't filled by a Senate vote at all.
segments.tr: Durante a maior parte da história do CDC, ele não era preenchido por votação do Senado.

segments.src: ## What the Senate actually did
segments.tr: ## O que o Senado realmente fez

segments.src: The vote itself was procedurally ordinary and politically anything but.
segments.tr: A votação em si foi procedimentalmente comum e politicamente tudo, menos isso.

segments.src: Fifty-one senators voted yes, forty-four voted no, and the tally broke largely along party lines.
segments.tr: Cinquenta e um senadores votaram sim, quarenta e quatro votaram não, e a contagem dividiu-se amplamente por linhas partidárias.

segments.src: What makes the outcome notable is that, only weeks earlier, the nomination looked finished.
segments.tr: O que torna o resultado notável é que, apenas semanas antes, a nomeação parecia finalizada.

segments.src: Schwartz had a rough outing before the committee that handles health nominations — the kind of hearing where a nominee absorbs sustained questioning, gives answers that satisfy few people in the room, and leaves with the whip count moving in the wrong direction.
segments.tr: Schwartz teve uma experiância difícil perante o comité que lida com nomeações de saùde — o tipo de audição onde um nomeado absorve questionamentos constantes, fornece respostas que satisfazem poucas pessoas na sala e sai com a contagem de votos movendo-se na direção errada.

segments.src: Nominations that stumble at that stage frequently do not recover.
segments.tr: Nomeações que tropeçam nessa fase frequentemente não se recuperam.

segments.src: Senators quietly signal that they'd rather not have to vote, the White House quietly looks elsewhere, and the nomination expires without a floor vote ever being scheduled.
segments.tr: Senadores sinalizam discretamente que prefeririam não ter que votar, a Casa Branca procura discretamente outro nome, e a nomeação expira sem que uma votação no plenário seja sequer agendada.

segments.src: That is roughly what had already happened once in this seat.
segments.tr: Isso é aproximadamente o que já havia acontecido uma vez para este cargo.

segments.src: This time it didn't.
segments.tr: Desta vez não.

segments.src: ## Why the chair sat empty so long
segments.tr: ## Por que a cadeira ficou vazia por tanto tempo

segments.src: The vacancy traces back to the summer of 2025.
segments.tr: A vacância remonta ao verão de 2025.

segments.src: The CDC director became a Senate-confirmed position beginning in January 2025, the result of a change Congress wrote into appropriations law in 2022.
segments.tr: O cargo de diretor do CDC tornou-se uma posição confirmada pelo Senado a partir de janeiro de 2025, resultado de uma mudança que o Congresso escreveu na lei de apropriações em 2022.

segments.src: Before that, the director was appointed directly by the Secretary of Health and Human Services — no hearing, no floor vote, no confirmation fight.
segments.tr: Antes disso, o diretor era nomeado diretamente pelo Secretário de Saùde e Serviços Humanos — sem audição, sem votação no plenário, sem luta por confirmação.

segments.src: A president could install a new director in an afternoon.
segments.tr: Um presidente podia instalar um novo diretor em uma tarde.

segments.src: The first director confirmed under the new rules took office in July 2025 and departed roughly a month later amid a public dispute over the agency's direction.
segments.tr: O primeiro diretor confirmado sob as novas regras assumiu o cargo em julho de 2025 e partiu aproximadamente um mâs depois em meio a uma disputa pùblica sobre a direção da agância.

segments.src: Several senior CDC officials resigned in the days that followed.
segments.tr: Vários altos funcionários do CDC renunciaram nos dias seguintes.

segments.src: The agency was then run on an acting basis by an official detailed from the department's leadership — a workable arrangement for weeks, an awkward one for months.
segments.tr: A agância foi então administrada em base interina por um funcionário detalhado da liderança do departamento — um arranjo viável por semanas, mas constrangedor por meses.

segments.src: A subsequent attempt to fill the job permanently did not survive the confirmation process.
segments.tr: Uma tentativa subsequente de preencher o cargo permanentemente não sobreviveu ao processo de confirmação.

segments.src: Meanwhile the agency absorbed budget reductions and staff departures that thinned out parts of its workforce.
segments.tr: Enquanto isso, a agância absorveu reduções orçamentárias e partidas de equipes que reduziram partes de sua força de trabalho.

segments.src: The result was an institution operating for the better part of a year without a leader who could credibly say they'd be there in six months.
segments.tr: O resultado foi uma instituição operando por quase um ano sem um líder que pudesse dizer com credibilidade que estaria lí there em seis meses.

segments.src: That matters more than it sounds.
segments.tr: Isso importa mais do que parece.

segments.src: Acting directors can keep the lights on, sign what needs signing, and manage an emergency if one arrives.
segments.tr: Diretores interinos podem manter as luzes acesas, assinar o que precisa ser assinado e gerenciar uma emergância se ela surgir.

segments.src: What they generally cannot do is make multi-year commitments — reorganize divisions, launch long-horizon surveillance programs, or recruit senior scientists who want to know who their boss will be.
segments.tr: O que eles geralmente não podem fazer é assumir compromissos plurianuais — reorganizar divisões, lançar programas de vigilância de longo prazo ou recrutar cientistas sâoiores que queiram saber quem será seu chefe.

segments.src: Career staff learn to wait out temporary leadership.
segments.tr: A equipe de carreira aprende a esperar a liderança temporária passar.

segments.src: Vacancies at the top tend to freeze decisions several layers down.
segments.tr: Vacâncias no topo tendem a congelar decisões várias camadas abaixo.

segments.src: ## The office became partisan before the person did
segments.tr: ## O cargo tornou-se partidário antes da pessoa

segments.tr: É tentador ler uma margem de 51–44 como um veredito sobre um nomeado.

segments.src: It's more useful to read it as a verdict on the job.
segments.tr: É mais ùtil lé-la como um veredito sobre o cargo.

segments.src: And the seat can sit empty for a year, because an empty seat is a survivable outcome for everyone except the agency.

segments.src: But it is the trade-off, and this vacancy is the clearest demonstration of it so far.
segments.tr: Mas é a troca, e esta vacância é a demonstração mais clara disso até agora.

segments.tr: **Ser a primeira.** A dimensão histórica da nomeação carrega seu próprio peso.

in.title: CDC Menghabiskan Hampir Setahun Tanpa Direktur Terkonfirmasi. Pemungutan Suara 51–44 Baru Saja Mengakhiri Hal Itu.

segments.src: On August 5, the Senate voted 51–44 to confirm Dr.
segments.tr: Pada tanggal 5 Agustus, Senat memberikan suara 51–44 untuk mengonfirmasi Dr.

segments.src: Erica Schwartz as director of the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention — closing out a vacancy that had stretched for close to a year at the agency responsible for tracking and responding to disease outbreaks in the United States.
segments.tr: Erica Schwartz sebagai direktur Centers for Disease Control and Prevention — mengakhiri kekosongan jabatan yang telah berlangsung selama hampir setahun di lembaga yang bertanggung jawab untuk melacak dan menanggapi wabah penyakit di Amerika Serikat.

segments.src: She becomes the CDC's 22nd director and the first Black woman to hold the post.
segments.tr: Ia menjadi direktur CDC ke-22 dan wanita kulit hitam pertama yang memegang jabatan tersebut.

segments.src: Both halves of that sentence deserve attention, but so does the number attached to it.
segments.tr: Kedua bagian dari kalimat itu layak mendapatkan perhatian, tetapi begitu juga dengan angka yang menyertainya.

segments.src: A seven-vote margin, along a mostly party-line split, is not how the top job at a scientific agency was historically filled.
segments.tr: Margin tujuh suara, dengan pembagian yang sebagian besar berdasarkan garis partai, bukanlah cara jabatan tertinggi di lembaga ilmiah secara historis diisi.

segments.src: For most of the CDC's history, it wasn't filled by a Senate vote at all.
segments.tr: Sepanjang sebagian besar sejarah CDC, jabatan itu tidak diisi melalui pemungutan suara Senat sama sekali.

segments.src: ## What the Senate actually did
segments.tr: ## Apa yang sebenarnya dilakukan Senat

segments.src: The vote itself was procedurally ordinary and politically anything but.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara itu sendiri secara prosedural biasa, namun secara politik sangat tidak biasa.

segments.src: Fifty-one senators voted yes, forty-four voted no, and the tally broke largely along party lines.
segments.tr: Lima puluh satu senator memberikan suara ya, empat puluh empat memberikan suara tidak, dan hitungan suara terbagi sebagian besar berdasarkan garis partai.

segments.src: What makes the outcome notable is that, only weeks earlier, the nomination looked finished.
segments.tr: Yang membuat hasil ini menjadi penting adalah bahwa, hanya beberapa minggu sebelumnya, pencalonan tersebut tampak sudah berakhir.

segments.src: Schwartz had a rough outing before the committee that handles health nominations — the kind of hearing where a nominee absorbs sustained questioning, gives answers that satisfy few people in the room, and leaves with the whip count moving in the wrong direction.
segments.tr: Schwartz mengalami masa sulit sebelum komite yang menangani pencalonan kesehatan — jenis sidang di mana seorang calon menerima pertanyaan tajam yang terus-menerus, memberikan jawaban yang memuaskan sedikit orang di ruangan itu, dan pergi dengan jumlah suara yang bergerak ke arah yang salah.

segments.src: Nominations that stumble at that stage frequently do not recover.
segments.tr: Pencalonan yang tersandung di tahap itu sering kali tidak pulih.

segments.src: Senators quietly signal that they'd rather not have to vote, the White House quietly looks elsewhere, and the nomination expires without a floor vote ever being scheduled.
segments.tr: Senator secara diam-diam memberi sinyal bahwa mereka lebih suka tidak perlu memberikan suara, Gedung Putih secara diam-diam mencari pengganti, dan pencalonan tersebut berakhir tanpa pemungutan suara lantai yang pernah dijadwalkan.

segments.src: That is roughly what had already happened once in this seat.
segments.tr: Itulah kira-kira yang sudah terjadi sekali dalam jabatan ini.

segments.src: This time it didn't.
segments.tr: Kali ini tidak.

segments.src: ## Why the chair sat empty so long
segments.tr: ## Mengapa kursi itu kosong begitu lama

segments.src: The vacancy traces back to the summer of 2025.
segments.tr: Kekosongan itu bermula dari musim panas 2025.

segments.src: The CDC director became a Senate-confirmed position beginning in January 2025, the result of a change Congress wrote into appropriations law in 2022.
segments.tr: Direktur CDC menjadi posisi yang dikonfirmasi oleh Senat mulai Januari 2025, hasil dari perubahan yang ditulis Kongres ke dalam undang-undang apropriasinya pada tahun 2022.

segments.src: Before that, the director was appointed directly by the Secretary of Health and Human Services — no hearing, no floor vote, no confirmation fight.
segments.tr: Sebelum itu, direktur ditunjuk langsung oleh Sekretaris Kesehatan dan Layanan Kemanusiaan — tidak ada sidang, tidak ada pemungutan suara lantai, tidak ada pertarungan konfirmasi.

segments.src: A president could install a new director in an afternoon.
segments.tr: Seorang presiden bisa memasang direktur baru dalam satu sore.

segments.src: The first director confirmed under the new rules took office in July 2025 and departed roughly a month later amid a public dispute over the agency's direction.
segments.tr: Direktur pertama yang dikonfirmasi di bawah aturan baru menjabat pada Juli 2025 dan pergi kira-kira sebulan kemudian di tengah perselisihan publik atas arah lembaga tersebut.

segments.src: Several senior CDC officials resigned in the days that followed.
segments.tr: Beberapa pejabat senior CDC mengundurkan diri pada hari-hari berikutnya.

segments.src: The agency was then run on an acting basis by an official detailed from the department's leadership — a workable arrangement for weeks, an awkward one for months.
segments.tr: Lembaga tersebut kemudian dijalankan secara sementara oleh seorang pejabat yang ditugaskan dari kepemimpinan departemen — sebuah pengaturan yang dapat berjalan untuk beberapa minggu, namun canggung untuk beberapa bulan.

segments.src: A subsequent attempt to fill the job permanently did not survive the confirmation process.
segments.tr: Upaya selanjutnya untuk mengisi jabatan tersebut secara permanen tidak bertahan dalam proses konfirmasi.

segments.src: Meanwhile the agency absorbed budget reductions and staff departures that thinned out parts of its workforce.
segments.tr: Sementara itu, lembaga tersebut menyerap pengurangan anggaran dan pengunduran diri staf yang menipiskan sebagian dari tenaga kerjanya.

segments.src: The result was an institution operating for the better part of a year without a leader who could credibly say they'd be there in six months.
segments.tr: Hasilnya adalah sebuah institusi yang beroperasi selama sebagian besar setahun tanpa pemimpin yang dapat secara kredibel mengatakan bahwa mereka akan berada di sana dalam enam bulan.

segments.src: That matters more than it sounds.
segments.tr: Hal itu lebih penting daripada kedengarannya.

segments.src: Acting directors can keep the lights on, sign what needs signing, and manage an emergency if one arrives.
segments.tr: Direktur sementara dapat menjaga operasional tetap berjalan, menandatangani apa yang perlu ditandatangani, dan mengelola keadaan darurat jika terjadi.

segments.src: What they generally cannot do is make multi-year commitments — reorganize divisions, launch long-horizon surveillance programs, or recruit senior scientists who want to know who their boss will be.
segments.tr: Apa yang umumnya tidak dapat mereka lakukan adalah membuat komitmen multi-tahun — mengorganisasi ulang divisi, meluncurkan program pengawasan jangka panjang, atau merekrut ilmuwan senior yang ingin tahu siapa bos mereka nantinya.

segments.src: Career staff learn to wait out temporary leadership.
segments.tr: Staf karier belajar untuk menunggu kepemimpinan sementara berlalu.

segments.src: Vacancies at the top tend to freeze decisions several layers down.
segments.tr: Kekosongan di puncak cenderung membekukan keputusan di beberapa lapisan di bawahnya.

segments.src: ## The office became partisan before the person did
segments.tr: ## Jabatan tersebut menjadi partisan sebelum orangnya

segments.src: It's tempting to read a 51–44 margin as a verdict on one nominee.
segments.tr: Sangat menggoda untuk membaca margin 51–44 sebagai vonis atas satu calon.

segments.src: It's more useful to read it as a verdict on the job.
segments.tr: Lebih berguna untuk membacanya sebagai vonis atas jabatan tersebut.

segments.src: Confirmation votes for public health agency leadership were not always contested affairs.
segments.tr: Pemungutan suara konfirmasi untuk kepemimpinan lembaga kesehatan masyarakat tidak selalu menjadi urusan yang diperebutkan.

segments.src: The change in 2022 that made the CDC director subject to Senate confirmation was framed at the time as an accountability measure — a response to the sense, held in different forms across the political spectrum, that the agency had made consequential decisions during the pandemic without enough external check.
segments.tr: Perubahan pada tahun 2022 yang membuat direktur CDC tunduk pada konfirmasi Senat dibingkai pada saat itu sebagai langkah akuntabilitas — respons terhadap perasaan, yang dipegang dalam berbagai bentuk di seluruh spektrum politik, bahwa lembaga tersebut telah membuat keputusan penting selama pandemi tanpa cukup pemeriksaan eksternal.

segments.src: The predictable second-order effect is now visible.
segments.tr: Efek sekunder yang dapat diprediksi sekarang terlihat.

segments.src: Once a post requires 51 votes, it acquires the properties of every other job that requires 51 votes.
segments.tr: Begitu sebuah jabatan memerlukan 51 suara, ia memperoleh sifat-sifat dari setiap jabatan lain yang memerlukan 51 suara.

segments.src: Nominees are evaluated partly on credentials and partly on which coalition they're understood to belong to.
segments.tr: Calon dievaluasi sebagian berdasarkan kredensial dan sebagian berdasarkan koalisi mana yang mereka dianggap milik.

segments.src: Hearings become opportunities to litigate the last five years of health policy with a person who wasn't in charge for any of it.
segments.tr: Sidang menjadi kesempatan untuk memperdebatkan kebijakan kesehatan lima tahun terakhir dengan orang yang tidak memimpin selama periode tersebut.

segments.src: And the seat can sit empty for a year, because an empty seat is a survivable outcome for everyone except the agency.
segments.tr: Dan kursi itu bisa kosong selama setahun, karena kursi kosong adalah hasil yang dapat ditoleransi bagi semua orang kecuali lembaga tersebut.

segments.src: Accountability and paralysis turn out to be produced by the same mechanism.
segments.tr: Akuntabilitas dan kelumpuhan ternyata dihasilkan oleh mekanisme yang sama.

segments.src: That's not an argument that the 2022 change was wrong — reasonable people land in different places on whether a director of a 10,000-person agency with emergency authorities should face a public vote.
segments.tr: Itu bukan argumen bahwa perubahan tahun 2022 itu salah — orang-orang yang masuk akal memiliki pandangan berbeda tentang apakah direktur lembaga dengan 10.000 orang dengan wewenang darurat harus menghadapi pemungutan suara publik.

segments.src: But it is the trade-off, and this vacancy is the clearest demonstration of it so far.
segments.tr: Namun, itulah pertukarannya, dan kekosongan ini adalah demonstrasi terjelas darinya sejauh ini.

segments.src: ## What lands on her desk
segments.tr: ## Apa yang mendarat di mejanya

segments.src: The incoming director inherits a specific and unglamorous list.
segments.tr: Direktur yang baru menjabat mewarisi daftar tugas yang spesifik dan tidak glamor.

segments.src: **Staffing.** Budget reductions and resignations have left gaps, including in senior scientific ranks.
segments.tr: **Staf.** Pengurangan anggaran dan pengunduran diri telah meninggalkan celah, termasuk dalam jajaran ilmiah senior.

segments.src: Rebuilding takes longer than cutting, and the people who left had institutional knowledge that doesn't come back with the job posting.
segments.tr: Membangun kembali membutuhkan waktu lebih lama daripada memotong, dan orang-orang yang pergi memiliki pengetahuan institusional yang tidak kembali bersama dengan lowongan pekerjaan.

segments.src: **The advisory apparatus.** The CDC relies on outside expert committees whose composition and processes have been the subject of sustained public argument.
segments.tr: **Aparatus penasihat.** CDC mengandalkan komite ahli luar yang komposisi dan prosesnya telah menjadi subjek argumen publik yang terus-menerus.

segments.src: How the new director handles those bodies will be an early signal of how much independence the agency's scientific process is understood to have.
segments.tr: Bagaimana direktur baru menangani badan-badan tersebut akan menjadi sinyal awal tentang seberapa besar independensi yang dipahami proses ilmiah lembaga tersebut.

segments.src: **Trust, which is not one number.** Public confidence in the CDC is not uniformly high or uniformly low — it varies enormously by political affiliation, and the gap between groups is now wider than it was before 2020.
segments.tr: **Kepercayaan, yang bukan satu angka.** Kepercayaan publik terhadap CDC tidak secara seragam tinggi atau rendah — hal itu sangat bervariasi berdasarkan afiliasi politik, dan celah antara kelompok-kelompok tersebut sekarang lebih lebar daripada sebelum tahun 2020.

segments.src: A director cannot close that gap by communicating more clearly, though communicating clearly helps.
segments.tr: Seorang direktur tidak dapat menutup celah itu hanya dengan berkomunikasi lebih jelas, meskipun berkomunikasi dengan jelas itu membantu.

segments.src: It's a structural problem the agency did not create alone and cannot solve alone.
segments.tr: Ini adalah masalah struktural yang tidak diciptakan oleh lembaga tersebut sendirian dan tidak dapat diselesaikan sendirian.

segments.src: **The next outbreak, whenever it is.** This is the part no one can schedule.
segments.tr: **Wabah berikutnya, kapan pun itu.** Ini adalah bagian yang tidak bisa dijadwalkan oleh siapa pun.

segments.src: The practical test of any CDC director is how the agency performs in the first ninety days of something nobody saw coming — and that test is graded on preparation done long beforehand.
segments.tr: Ujian praktis dari setiap direktur CDC adalah bagaimana lembaga tersebut berkinerja dalam sembilan puluh hari pertama dari sesuatu yang tidak diduga oleh siapa pun — dan ujian itu dinilai berdasarkan persiapan yang dilakukan jauh sebelumnya.

segments.src: **Being the first.** The historic dimension of the appointment carries its own weight.
segments.tr: **Menjadi yang pertama.** Dimensi historis dari penunjukan ini membawa bebannya sendiri.

segments.src: Firsts are scrutinized differently, and the scrutiny doesn't lift after the first year.
segments.tr: Yang pertama selalu dicermati dengan cara yang berbeda, dan pencermatan itu tidak hilang setelah tahun pertama.

segments.src: ## What we know, and what we don't
segments.tr: ## Apa yang kita ketahui, dan apa yang tidak

segments.src: Worth separating clearly, because early coverage of any confirmation blends the two.
segments.tr: Penting untuk memisahkan dengan jelas, karena liputan awal dari konfirmasi apa pun mencampurkan keduanya.

segments.src: **Established:** the date, the 51–44 margin, the roughly party-line split, the length of the vacancy, and the historic nature of the appointment.
segments.tr: **Sudah ditetapkan:** tanggal, margin 51–44, pembagian yang kira-kira berdasarkan garis partai, lamanya kekosongan, dan sifat historis dari penunjukan tersebut.

segments.src: **Not yet established:** what she will actually do.
segments.tr: **Belum ditetapkan:** apa yang sebenarnya akan dia lakukan.

segments.src: Confirmation hearings are a poor predictor of governance.
segments.tr: Sidang konfirmasi adalah prediktor yang buruk untuk tata kelola.

segments.src: Nominees answer hypotheticals under adversarial conditions; directors make decisions under real ones with information the hearing room didn't have.
segments.tr: Calon menjawab pengandaian di bawah kondisi yang saling berlawanan; direktur membuat keputusan di bawah kondisi nyata dengan informasi yang tidak dimiliki ruang sidang.

segments.src: Personnel choices in the first sixty days will say more than anything said in testimony.
segments.tr: Pilihan personel dalam enam puluh hari pertama akan mengatakan lebih banyak daripada apa pun yang dikatakan dalam kesaksian.

segments.src: **Contested:** essentially all of the surrounding interpretation.
segments.tr: **Diperebutkan:** pada dasarnya semua interpretasi di sekitarnya.

segments.src: Whether the last year represents necessary correction or damaging disruption is a live political argument, and coverage of this confirmation will reflect whichever answer the outlet already holds.
segments.tr: Apakah tahun terakhir mewakili koreksi yang diperlukan atau gangguan yang merusak adalah argumen politik yang nyata, dan liputan tentang konfirmasi ini akan mencerminkan jawaban mana pun yang sudah dipegang oleh outlet tersebut.

segments.src: Reading across sources is more useful here than usual.
segments.tr: Membaca dari berbagai sumber lebih berguna di sini daripada biasanya.

segments.src: ## Why this is worth following
segments.tr: ## Mengapa ini layak diikuti

segments.src: The CDC is an agency most Americans think about only when something has gone wrong — which means the periods when nothing is going wrong are exactly when its capacity gets built or quietly eroded.
segments.tr: CDC adalah lembaga yang dipikirkan oleh sebagian besar orang Amerika hanya ketika ada sesuatu yang salah — yang berarti periode ketika tidak ada yang salah adalah tepat saat kapasitasnya dibangun atau secara diam-diam terkikis.

segments.src: A confirmed director doesn't fix an agency.
segments.tr: Direktur yang terkonfirmasi tidak memperbaiki lembaga tersebut.

segments.src: It restores the precondition for fixing one: someone with the standing to make decisions that outlast the news cycle, and the accountability that comes with having been voted on in public.
segments.tr: Hal itu memulihkan prasyarat untuk memperbaikinya: seseorang dengan kedudukan untuk membuat keputusan yang bertahan lebih lama dari siklus berita, dan akuntabilitas yang datang dengan telah dipungut suaranya secara publik.

segments.src: Whether the vote that ended the vacancy also ended the underlying instability is a separate question.
segments.tr: Apakah pemungutan suara yang mengakhiri kekosongan tersebut juga mengakhiri ketidakstabilan yang mendasarinya adalah pertanyaan terpisah.

segments.src: Nothing about a 51–44 margin suggests the argument is over.
segments.tr: Tidak ada hal tentang margin 51–44 yang menunjukkan bahwa argumen tersebut telah berakhir.

segments.src: It suggests the argument now has a permanent address.
segments.tr: Hal itu menunjukkan bahwa argumen tersebut sekarang memiliki alamat permanen.

segments.tr: *Artikel ini merangkum perkembangan yang dilaporkan secara publik per 7 Agustus 2026.

segments.src: Details of personnel decisions and agency policy may change; for official announcements, consult the CDC and the Department of Health and Human Services directly, and check current reporting from established news organizations for the latest developments.*
segments.tr: Detail keputusan personel dan kebijakan lembaga dapat berubah; untuk pengumuman resmi, konsultasikan langsung dengan CDC dan Departemen Kesehatan dan Layanan Kemanusiaan, dan periksa laporan terbaru dari organisasi berita terkemuka untuk perkembangan terbaru.*
